content: 'Aitsika memɨyɨhɨritɨa wahetsiemieme
Yawé Muitsexi katiniuta'aitɨani
'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ mɨtiwatahɨawekɨ: «Xɨka xewitɨ 'uki yatɨni 'ukaratsi natsareyukɨ yɨhɨritɨamɨkɨni, Yawé hɨxie yake'utayɨni,
mɨkɨ kaxie winuyari pɨkaye'eni matsiwi meta kwinimieme mɨratsiwi. Meta hipame winu, kaxie hayari, kaxie takariyari mɨpatsarutsietɨka pɨkakwa'ani.
Mexi kexemɨte'uxa 'areutewini natsareyu hepaɨ, kaxie takariyari xepɨkakwa'ani meta kararayari hatsiyari nitɨma.
»Mexi 'areutewini Yawé hetsiemieme patsietɨ, tatsɨari natsareyu hepaɨ pɨtimatsiɨkɨni, yaxeikɨata pɨka'ikaxikani yukɨpa matsi kanihayewakamɨkɨ mɨtiwawerekɨ meta puyukweriwayurieka 'itiyatɨ.
»Kepauka mɨpaɨ 'anetɨ muyeikani Yawé hɨxie, mɨki manukatsie 'ahurawa pɨka'uyeikani,
tsepa paapaya, maamaya, mutaya, kurieya memukwi. Mɨkɨ wahekɨ ka'iyatɨ pɨkahayuyeitɨwani, matsi mɨpaɨ pɨkayɨaneni Yawé 'inɨarieya mexeiyakɨ yumu'utsie.
Kepauka patsietɨ 'amuyeikani Yawé hetsiemieme, yu'itietɨ kaniuyeikamɨkɨ patsietɨ.
»Xɨka 'atsikara'eriwakaku xewitɨ 'auriena 'umɨni, yumu'utsie kemɨtipatsiekai mɨpaɨ ka'anetɨ kanayeimɨkɨ, 'atahuta tukari heutineyu, kepauka mɨ'itiyanitsie, 'ana naime yumu'utsie kaniyukaximɨkɨ.
'Atahaika tukari heutineyu yuhutame kukuruxi kaniwaranɨtɨkimɨkɨ yatɨni haɨmɨxi, mawari wewiwame kaniyetuiriemɨkɨ 'ixuriki tukiyari mɨranutahakitɨretsie muka memayutixexeɨriwatsie.

Mɨkɨ xeime mawari wewiwame kanitimawamɨkɨ 'itiya mawariyari meta hipame mawari taiyariyari mɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ. 'Ana mawari wewiwame natsareyu patsiekame kaneyeitɨamɨkɨ, 'ikɨ 'axamɨtiuyurikɨ mɨki 'umayɨaka. 'Ana mɨkɨ tukaritsie natsareyu pɨ'itiyani yumu'utsie,

'axakemɨtiyurienekai natsareyu Yawé hɨxie 'aixɨa pɨyɨyuriekai muxatsi warehapanatɨ xeiwiyari mehɨtɨkaime mawariwewietɨ mɨkɨkɨ mɨreuyehɨwiyariekakɨ. 'Ayumieme pɨkanaki'eriwani meripai mieme matsi puhayewariekairi 'aixɨa mɨka'uyuyurikɨ mana pɨtiuyu'a.
»'Ikɨ 'inɨari natsareyu hetsiemieme kanihɨkɨtɨni kepauka manutinetɨarieni patsietɨ. Nanuwitɨkiemɨkɨ tuki kitenieyaritsie,
mana katinitimawamɨkɨ kanitataiyamɨkɨ muxa Yawé hetsiemieme xeiwiyari hɨkame katikuyeme, meta xeime muxa 'ukitɨme 'itiya mawariyari mayanikɨ, meta 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari.

Meta kanitimawamɨkɨ xeitsikɨiwitiyari paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka, meta tɨriku mɨtɨxiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane pɨhɨkɨtɨni wiyamatɨkaitɨ, tsuiraxi kakuxanariyarietɨkaime wiyamatɨkaime xeikɨa meta hatsite mawariyari, metatsiere kaxie winuyari mɨtiyeuriwa yɨnɨkame.
»Hikɨ mawari wewiwame Yawé hɨxie kanitimawamɨkɨ, mawarika mɨreuyehɨwiyarienikɨ, mawarika taiyariyari natsareyu hetsiemieme.
Muxa 'uki kanitimawamɨkɨ Yawé hetsiemieme 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari mayanikɨ, paa xeitsikɨiwitiyari hamatɨa. Meta hatsite kanitimawamɨkɨ metatsiere kaxie winuyari mɨtiyeuriwa yɨnɨkame.
»Hikɨ tuki kitenie memayutixexeɨriwatsie natsareyu kaniyukaximɨkɨ yumu'utsie. Yukɨpa mupatsietɨka, taipa kaneuwiwimɨkɨ 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari mataiyarietsie.
»'Ariri natsareyu yukaxiyu, mawari wewiwame paa kananatituimɨkɨ tsikɨiwititsie mɨkakuxanariyarie meta muxa 'uki naiparieya, mɨkɨ naime natsareyu katinipitɨamɨkɨ,

'anaketa naime Yawé hɨxie pekaniyuitɨwamɨkɨ mawarika hepaɨ. Naitɨ katinipatsieka mawari wewiwame hetsiemieme katinihɨkɨtɨni, naitɨ tawitsiemieme, teurite kɨmana mɨrayukatuiya. Mɨpaɨ tiyurieme naime natsareyu winu manu'ieni kaniyɨweni.

»'Ikɨ 'inɨari kani'ayumiemetɨni kemɨ'ane natsareyukɨ mɨyɨhɨritɨani. 'Ikɨ naime mawarika katiniwewimɨkɨ Yawé hetsiemieme natsareyu hetsiemieme meta kaniyɨweni tita mɨtiyetuani ketita mɨrexeiyani. 'Inɨari kemaine natsareyu hetsiemieme, xɨka natsareyu yuyeitɨamɨkɨni kaneye'atɨamɨkɨ kemaine».
Mawari wewiwamete hipame 'aixɨa memɨwayurienikɨ
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aitɨani:
«Mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi 'Aruni meta niwemama, 'ixaheritsixi 'aixɨa memɨwayuriekakɨ 'ikɨ niukikɨ:
»Mɨpaɨ xeputiyuaneni kenemɨtitewa 'ixaheritsixi watsata, yurikɨ ne neheyemekɨ nemɨxe'ɨwiyanikɨ».
